The applicant must be in the age group of 18-59 years.
rules.note: SOURCE CONFLICT — same FAQ source issue as IGNWPS-IN-R02. NSAP FAQ Q20 (IGNDPS-IN-ELIGIBILITY-01, official) states '18-59 years'. If the revised NSAP guidelines confirm the widow/disability ceiling was raised to 79, this rule may also need updating. Value set to 59 from the FAQ pending official NSAP guidelines PDF confirmation. Needs domain owner sign-off per POLICY.md §2.

rules.source_quote: The applicant should be a resident of India.
rules.note: Residency is not explicitly stated in the NSAP FAQ (Q20). The passage is flagged needs_recollection. This rule should be re-verified against an official NSAP source that explicitly states a residency or citizenship requirement.

rules.source_quote: The applicant should be a person with severe or multiple disabilities.
The applicant should be a person with severe or multiple disabilities.
rules.note: Resolved to 80% or more (inclusive). NSAP FAQ (Q20) states 'severe or multiple disabilities'; the 80% threshold is derived from RPwD Act 2016 Section 2(r). Confirmed by Vivian 2026-11-12. Discovery reference: https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/scheme/detail/indira-gandhi-national-disability-pension-scheme_igndps.html (UMANG, discovery only per POLICY.md §3).

rules.source_quote: The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line.
